messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Leadership | Government Relations, ESG and Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Elevate Spark Team,

Your Saudi-based focus on leadership and board recruitment, strategic talent advisory, workforce excellence and Vision 2030 transformation makes this a strong fit for my background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major multinational mining operation.

My strongest value is in complex regulated environments where leadership must align government interfaces, investment priorities, institutional trust, sustainability performance and operational execution. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority.

I would welcome confidential consideration for Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, Government Relations, External or Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across energy, mining, infrastructure, sovereign-linked and other high-growth organisations.

My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
